senses.definition: n.[m.] a shaking, wagging;—only cstr. מְנוֹד רֹאשׁ ψ 44:15 object of head-shaking, in derision (of Isr.; ‖ מָשָׁל; v 14 חֶרְפָּה, לַעַג, קֶלֶס).
